原文：Mesh Renderer objects have been baked into a skinned mesh. Each source object
 is still in the scene (with renderer disabled) and becomes a bone. Any scripts, animations,
 or physics that affect the invisible source objects will be visible in the
Skinned Mesh. This approach is more efficient than either dynamic batching or updating every frame 
 for many small objects that constantly and independently move. 
 With this approach pay attention to the SkinnedMeshRenderer Bounds and Animation Culling
settings. You may need to write your own script to manage/update these or your object may vanish or stop animating.
 You can update the combined mesh at runtime as objects are added and deleted from the scene.

 Try one or more of the following: using multiple atlases, increase the maximum atlas size, don't use 'force-power-of-two', remove the source materials that are are using very small/thin textures.
